title: ShowExpression
description: expression (since 1.15): she shows an expression on her face now (her set_expression function), for a few seconds, over her mood's face. The node fades it in, holds it and fades it out; an expression her model does not have is ignored, and a null expression ends the one shown. A node may ignore the frame.

expression.description: The name of the expression of her model (a VRM preset such as happy, sad, angry, relaxed, surprised, or one of the model's own); null ends the one shown.

weight.description: How strong it is, 0 to 1; null for 0.8.

seconds.description: How long it is held, at most 60; null for 4.
